item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I like the idea but the article is really, really inconsistent.

"the organism behaves exactly as a normal cat, and its host is always capable of describing what it is currently doing and where it is within their head. SCP-637-2 shows affection for the theoretical creature." — Except when transferred to a D-class, the D-class eventually committed suicide. It's not clear whether SCP-637-2 is the original old lady or the new D-class host. I'm gonna guess the new D-class host probably hated cats.

Then there's this line: "If no uses are found for SCP-637, then it is believed that it will die when its host does." Followed by: "After twelve hours, the subject unexpectedly self-terminated using the broken edge of a ceramic dish (provided with its meal). The subject was observed making several loud remarks such as "Get the cat out! I want the cat out! Leave me alone!" and commenting that the organism was a "brain-sucking parasite" before death.
It is worth noting that at approximately the same time as D-67308's termination, SCP-637-2, who had been sleeping at the time, sat straight up and exclaimed, "Kitty's back!""

So we have no idea how other people react to it, just that they commit suicide. Also we have no idea what happens when the host dies, while noting that it goes back to the original host?
